kotobakeep.options.title: Kotoba Keep Settings
kotobakeep.options.setByServer: Learning and challenge rules are set by this server
kotobakeep.options.showRomaji.tooltip: Show the romaji reading next to the word.
kotobakeep.options.fadeHints.tooltip: Hide a word's romaji, then its furigana, once you keep getting it right. A wrong answer brings them back.
kotobakeep.options.hideRomajiAfter.toolt: Correct answers in a row before a word's romaji is hidden.
kotobakeep.options.hideFuriganaAfter.too: Correct answers in a row before a word's furigana is hidden.
kotobakeep.options.hudTop.tooltip: Distance of the challenge panel from the top of the screen.
kotobakeep.options.enabled.tooltip: Turn off to stop all challenges. Nothing is removed while it's off.
kotobakeep.options.gentleFirstMeeting.to: Failing a word the first time it's asked takes nothing. Penalties start from its second ask.
kotobakeep.options.limitNewWords.tooltip: Ask at most one brand-new word per New Word Gap. New items picked up in between are yours, and their words come later.
kotobakeep.options.growingReviewGaps.too: Each correct answer in a row waits the next of the Review Gaps before the word comes back. Off: a random wait between Review Wait Min and Max.
kotobakeep.options.newWordGapSeconds.too: With Limit New Words on: seconds between brand-new words.
kotobakeep.options.reviewGapMinutes.tool: With Growing Review Gaps on: minutes of play before each review, separated by commas. The last one repeats.
kotobakeep.options.repeatMinSeconds.tool: With Growing Review Gaps off, a learned word comes back after a random wait between Min and Max seconds of play.
kotobakeep.options.repeatMaxSeconds.tool: With Growing Review Gaps off, a learned word comes back after a random wait between Min and Max seconds of play.
kotobakeep.options.minimumChallengeSecon: Each word's timer depends on its length, within the shortest and longest timer.
kotobakeep.options.maximumChallengeSecon: Each word's timer depends on its length, within the shortest and longest timer.
kotobakeep.options.secondsPerMora.toolti: Extra time for each kana of the reading.
kotobakeep.options.recognitionGraceSecon: Extra time for speech recognition to finish after the timer ends.
kotobakeep.options.retryWindowSeconds.to: How long the "Need more time?" offer stays after a timeout.
kotobakeep.options.replayCostSeconds.too: Seconds a replay (J) takes off the timer. 0 turns replays off.
